notes.title: Minagoroshi On Sale Now!
notes.content:
[h1]Order Minagoroshi now and get 10% off during launch week!![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1034940/Higurashi_When_They_Cry_Hou__Ch7_Minagoroshi/

At long last, you can enjoy the sixth chapter of this exciting Visual Novel that spawned the highly-acclaimed Higurashi anime and manga series on Steam for the very first time! With updated sprites and other visuals, fans won't want to miss this new release!

In this chapter, Minagoroshi, Keiichi manages to make the choice that would avert the tragedies of Watanagashi and Meakashi. With this revelation that Keiichi and the others are beginning to learn from the events of prior chapters, Rika finally gains hope that there might be a way to end this relentless cycle. Yet those hopes are soon stifled with the arrival of Houjou Teppei, Satoko's abusive uncle. Can the club members avert the tragedy of Tatarigoroshi this time around? Will a different chain of events finally reveal the mastermind behind the tragedies of Hinamizawa? And also... who is the mysterious figure Rika seems to be talking to this time around?

The Answer Arcs continue, and revelations await. So keep your eyes open and don't miss out!

Don't forget to check out our 07th Expansion page either:

http://www.mangagamer.org/07thExpansion/

Help spread the word on twitter with #Higurashi and introduce new fans to this remastered version of such a great series from 07th Expansion!
